theorem even_normal_intersection_has_conjugacy_stable_involution {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
  (I : Type*) [Nonempty I] (H : I → Subgroup G)
  (hH : ∀ i : I, (H i).Normal)
  (hEven : Even (Nat.card (↥(⨅ i : I, H i)))) :
  ∃ x : G, orderOf x = 2 ∧ x ∈ (⨅ i : I, H i) ∧
    ∀ g : G, g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ (⨅ i : I, H i) := by
  rw [even_iff_two_dvd] at hEven
  haveI := Fact.mk hEven
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' 2 hEven
  use x
  constructor
  simp [hx]
  exact ⟨Subtype.mem x, fun g ↦ Subgroup.mem_iInf.mpr fun i ↦
    (hH i).conj_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp x.2 i) g⟩

    ∀ g : G, g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ (⨅ i : I, H i) := by

    intro i
    exact (hH i).conj_mem n (hn i) g
  
  refine ⟨x.1, ?_, x.2, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hx
  · exact hN.conj_mem x x.2

    rw [Subgroup.mem_iInf]
    intro i
